title: Slap Juice Salt Nic E-liquid – Kiberry Kick 30ml
description:
Description
Prepare to be transported to a taste paradise with Kiberry Kick; featuring a thrilling concoction of sun-kissed kiwis, succulent strawberries, and luscious watermelons that unleashes a wave of flavour on your palate!
Dive into the vibrant and electrifying world of Slap Juice, offering up distinct flavours to slap your taste buds! Each drop of Slap Juice is meticulously crafted with the finest ingredients, ensuring a smooth and satisfying vaping experience that’s second to none.
Slap Juice Salt-Nic E-Liquid is NOT intended for use in Sub-Ohm Tank systems. Slap Juice Salt-Nic E-Liquid is intended for small pod systems.
50% VG 50% PG
